newsitem.title: USA: IBM says FMR Corp owns 5.77 percent of IBM.
newsitem.headline: IBM says FMR Corp owns 5.77 percent of IBM.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said that FMR Corp owned 5.77 percent of IBM as of February 14, according to its proxy statement filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
FMR, the parent company of Fidelity Investments, owned a total of 29.8 million shares of IBM.

The schedule 13G filing reported that Edward Johnson, chairman of FMR and Abigail Johnson, director of FMR, together with other family members who are part of a controlling group of FMR, are the beneficial owners of the same shares, except that Edward Johnson's sole voting power is for 34,700 shares.
